text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2241112222 opened by deploy-bot 9: unexpected rate-limiter rollout caused exemptions to be dropped for legacy headers. Paging #incidents and #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Rolling rlim/v2.3 to us-central1 started at 2241112000. Canary 2%.

Nate: noticed customer error spike in metrics and direct CS messages. Rate-limit rejects for admin-api tokens jumped at ~2241112060.

Lina: checking charts 10s windows show throttle_count_admin up ~40% at that time.

Zoe: did we change header normalization in this release? @deploy-bot show commit

deploy-bot: Commit notes: standardize/exemptions: enable strict_normalize flag. Behavior: unknown header variants are no longer accepted implicitly.

Ravi: oh -- several internal services and two customers (FinCorp, AtlasPartners) still send legacy Exempt-Token header format.

Support-Bot: Support ticket 80123 opened by FinCorp: "major service disruption, admin API calls failing due to throttling".

Nate: this looks like a rollout regression. Proposed immediate steps: 1) flip rollout-suspend flag, 2) rollback to rlim/v2.2, 3) apply temporary route-level allowlist for affected customers, 4) patch parser to accept legacy formats.

Lina: I'll suspend the rollout now.

# command
POST https://config.svc.internal/flags/standardize.strict_normalize?action=disable

Lina: flag API 200 OK. rollout-suspend active.

deploy-bot: Rollout suspended. Existing canaries keep serving current config until restart.

Zoe: initiating rollback to v2.2

# command
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/rlim rlim=registry/internal/rlim:v2.2

deploy-bot: Rollback kicked off at 2241112101. ReplicaSet scaling to previous.

Nate: Ops, can we add temporary traffic bypass for FinCorp and AtlasPartners at the edge so they aren't throttled while we fix?

Ops-Bot: Applying edge allowlist for customers -> ttl 90m

# command
curl -X POST "https://edge.svc.internal/allowlist" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"customers":["FinCorp","AtlasPartners"],"duration":"90m"}'

Ops-Bot: allowlist applied. Early telemetry for FinCorp shows request success rate rising.

Zoe: logs show parser now returning explicit rejection:
```
ERROR exemptions.parser: unsupported header "Exempt-Token: oldformat" -> rejected
WARN rlim: treated as non-exempt, charging token usage
```

Ravi: yep that will cause extra charges on retries and higher throttle counts.

Nate: Devs, can we get a hotfix that accepts legacy "Exempt-Token" and normalizes it with a warn? Short patch only.

Zoe: creating branch hotfix/accept-legacy-2241112222. ETA build 18m.

deploy-bot: Hotfix build uploaded: rlim/hotfix-2241112222.

Lina: plan: deploy hotfix to 3% canary behind rollback state, validate, then ramp. Keep allowlist until stable.

# timeline note
2241112200: hotfix canary start 3%

Zoe: canary logs after hotfix show:
```
INFO exemptions.parser: legacy header "Exempt-Token: oldformat" normalized to "X-Exemption:legacy:xyz" (warn)
```

Nate: metrics look improved in canary window; throttle_count_admin back to baseline.

Lina: promoting hotfix to 40% at 2241112320.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete, no regressions observed.

Ravi: runbook action: verify token_balance metrics for internal admin tokens. There was token double-counting earlier; checking now.

Zoe: token_balance deltas normalized after hotfix deployment in canary.

Support-Bot: FinCorp confirms reduced throttling after allowlist and sees normal behavior now. ticket 80123 updated.

Nate: promoting to 100% at 2241112385.

deploy-bot: Hotfix fully promoted at 2241112390. rlim stable on hotfix-2241112222.

Lina: removing edge allowlist and monitoring closely.

# command
curl -X POST "https://edge.svc.internal/allowlist/remove" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" -d '{"customers":["FinCorp","AtlasPartners"]}'

Ops-Bot: allowlist removed. No customer regressions reported in 10m.

Nate: summary for execs: rollout of strict header normalization caused legacy exemption headers to be rejected leading to over-throttling of admin/internal tokens and two enterprise customers. Mitigations: rollout suspended, rollback, edge allowlist, hotfix deployed and promoted. Impact: approx peak 30-45% throttling for affected groups, no data loss, SLA blips for two customers. Postmortem scheduled.

Zoe: assigning postmortem to Zoe + Nate. Action items: 1) add regression tests for legacy exemption header formats, 2) include internal admin APIs in canary traffic, 3) add monitors for sudden exemption rejection spikes, 4) update deployment checklist to require feature-flag gated validation.

Nate: handing on-call back to Lina at 2241112450. incident-bot: creating postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Postmortem created: https://wiki.internal/incidents/2241112222. Severity: Sev2. Owners: Zoe, Nate.

Support-Bot: closing support ticket 80123 after FinCorp ack and final checks."
